headline: Restored 1894 clapboard colonial five minutes from the Ho-Hum ferry dock.
description: Set beneath mature American elms in the Bellport Lane Historic District, this four-bedroom captain's house pairs wide-plank heart pine floors and three wood-burning fireplaces with a 2023 chef's kitchen, screened dining porch, detached carriage barn studio, and room for a plunge pool behind established privet hedges. High-and-dry Zone X elevation with full Incorporated Village resident marina and Ho-Hum Beach ferry privileges.
personalNotes: Two autumn price cuts totaling $230k (-8.4%). Ideal walkability between Main St coffee and the Marina dock; verify ARB pool setback rules behind carriage barn.

headline: Turnkey cedar-shingle weekend compound with heated gunite pool near the Country Club.
description: Tucked behind tall privet on nearly three-quarters of an acre along the Country Club corridor, this sunlit cedar-shingle residence offers a first-floor primary suite, vaulted sunroom with bluestone terrace, 18x38 heated saline gunite pool, outdoor cedar shower, and turnkey four-season mechanicals including whole-house Generac generator. Two blocks from Bellport Country Club golf and tennis.
personalNotes: Strongest turnkey pool house under $2.25M. Zero renovation needed before Memorial Day; peak July/August rental demand easily covers carrying costs.

headline: Quiet off-market gambrel with legal guest cottage on tree-canopied Browns Lane.
description: Offered quietly prior to spring MLS launch: classic 1906 shingle-style Dutch gambrel featuring wrap-around covered porch, paneled library with fireplace, five upstairs/guest bedrooms, plus a separate one-bedroom legal guest cottage with kitchenette overlooking perennial English gardens and existing 16x34 heated pool.
personalNotes: Broker mentioned sellers prefer flexible spring closing. Guest cottage + pool on Browns Lane is rare.

headline: Warm cedar modern barn on quiet wooded half-acre inside Village limits.
description: An architect-led 2022 gut renovation on peaceful Circuit Road offering double-height great room with Danish wood stove, black steel casement windows, rift-oak kitchen, three generous bedrooms, wide mahogany deck, and approved town/village permit set for an 18x36 pool. Full Incorporated Village resident access to Ho-Hum Beach ferry, Marina, and Golf.
personalNotes: Best $/sqft value inside the Incorporated Village ($623/sqft) with low $13.9k taxes and pool permits already approved.

headline: Direct Bellport Bay frontage with panoramic Fire Island views and private boardwalk.
description: Rare direct waterfront along Shore Road with 135 feet of newly reconstructed Navy bulkhead, timber boardwalk through coastal marsh grass, unobstructed views across Bellport Bay to Fire Island, waterside dining porch, and elevated FEMA-compliant mechanicals. Steps from Bellport Yacht Club and Village Marina.
personalNotes: Unbeatable sunset bay views, but Flood Zone AE — check FEMA elevation certificate and annual flood insurance quote.

headline: Classic four-bedroom Cape on half-acre along Country Club Road with pool room.
description: Well-proportioned expanded Cape Cod residence with sunlit living room fireplace, formal dining room, first-floor guest bedroom, attached two-car garage, and deep flat south-facing backyard ideal for adding a pool and cabana. Walkable to both Main Street shops and the first tee at Bellport Country Club.
personalNotes: Two cuts totaling $175k! Kitchen and upstairs baths date to ~2008; great bones on an A+ street if bought around $1.55M.

headline: Nearly one private acre on cul-de-sac lane with heated pool and pool house.
description: Built in 2004 with nine-foot ceilings, central gourmet kitchen opening to family room, screened mahogany porch, 20x40 heated gunite pool, and seasonal pool house with half bath on a lush 0.92-acre parcel tucked off South Country Road inside Village boundaries.
personalNotes: New November listing — modern ceiling heights, cedar shingle exterior, screened porch, and huge lot for the Village.

headline: Charming 1922 village cottage two blocks from Main Street cafés and market.
description: Crisp low-maintenance weekend cottage featuring covered front porch, original wavy-glass windows, updated shaker kitchen, detached potting shed/studio, fenced perennial garden, and stone patio. Effortless lock-and-leave village living steps from Bellport General and Café Castello.
personalNotes: Smaller 0.24-acre lot (no room for full-size pool), but super charming low-upkeep weekend base.

headline: Sun-drenched 1912 shingle house on lower Otis Lane with bay glimpses.
description: Located near the southern terminus of Otis Lane with cooling Great South Bay breezes, sleeping porch, fieldstone hearth, and lush hydrangea gardens. Currently in contract after 22 days on market.
personalNotes: Went into contract fast despite lower-lane Zone AE. Keep an eye on final closing price as a comp.

headline: Entry-point Incorporated Village ranch ready for cosmetic reimagining.
description: Single-level three-bedroom ranch with hardwood floors, full basement, wood-burning fireplace, and private backyard inside the northern edge of Incorporated Bellport Village. Full resident eligibility for Ho-Hum Beach ferry and Village Marina.
personalNotes: Needs ~$250k+ renovation and further walk from the bay, though it gets the Village beach sticker.

headline: Bucolic 1.15-acre farmhouse just east in Brookhaven Hamlet (outside Village limits).
description: Spacious farmhouse with wrap-around porch, heated pool, and barn garage bordering Bellport's eastern edge. Note: Located in unincorporated Brookhaven Hamlet — does NOT include Incorporated Village of Bellport resident access to the Ho-Hum Beach ferry, and falls under Town of Brookhaven 28-night minimum rental rules.
personalNotes: Outside Village boundary: no Ho-Hum ferry resident pass AND Town of Brookhaven bans nightly Airbnbs (<28 nights).

headline: Recent benchmark Village sale at $645/sqft with heated pool and screened porch.
description: Sold at full asking price in autumn 2026: thoughtfully renovated four-bedroom shingle colonial with new cedar roof, screened porch, and heated saltwater pool on Circuit Road.
personalNotes: Key benchmark comp: $1.60M ($645/sqft) for renovated 4BR + pool on East Lanes.
